diagnosis.summary: The relay metric relay_up disappeared from Prometheus for >5 minutes.
diagnosis.likely_cause: Telemetry push starvation, not a relay outage.

evidence.loki_log: ingester failing healthcheck during the push window

issues.detail: still stale; log-store ingest recovery in progress

postmortem.summary: An ingest-side degradation in the log store caused HTTP 500s on log push; a single-threaded shipper then starved the metric upload; the relay metric went stale and tripped the alert. The relay unit itself (restarts=0, /healthz 200) was healthy throughout.
postmortem.fix: Decouple the metric push onto its own timer; tighten log-store limits for the small VM.
